name: context-menu
title: Context menu
what: One right-click menu any app links. The APP declares what can be right-clicked on its pages (kinds: a card, a row, an order) and what can be done to each (items) in one JSON catalog island; the component does everything a menu does -- pointer, Shift+F10 and the Menu key, touch long-press, arrow keys and type-ahead, tabs, submenus, a check on the current value, press-twice confirmation for anything destructive, the writes through the app's own endpoints and their toasts, each person's recently-used row, and a facts line showing the values behind the state. SMART (optional): with data-smart-url the hub's configured model organises the declared items for this app, page, kind and role -- pins the likeliest at the top, splits a long menu into tabs, drops optional items that make no sense here, and offers up to three questions for the page's agent. It can only name ids the app declared; it can never add or change an action, and a model that is down leaves the catalog's own order.

mount.element: -- link the script WITHOUT defer, immediately after the mount (and after the agent component when the page has one)

attributes.data-app: REQUIRED: the app slug; keys the recently-used memory, the props record and the smart pass
attributes.data-app-name: the name a person knows the app by
attributes.data-page: a short key for the page (board, list, register); the smart pass organises per page. Defaults to the path.
attributes.data-role: the reader's rung in this app (admin, member, visitor, ...); the model organises for it. Never a gate -- the app's endpoints gate every write.
attributes.data-smart-url: optional: a POST path on the APP's own origin that forwards the body to POST /hub/api/menu/rank with the app's hub credential (scope menu:rank). No smart-url, no model: the catalog's own order, and no star.
attributes.data-props: optional: the hub's component-properties route for this app

bridge.smart: POST JSON (the request below) -> forward to POST /hub/api/menu/rank with the app's hub credential (scope menu:rank); return the hub's JSON unchanged. Let the bridge wait a little longer than the hub's own model timeout, so the hub's verdict is the one a reader sees.

catalog.shape: {"kinds": {"<kind>": {"label": "Card", "match": "[data-task]", "id": "display-id task", "head": "{display-id}", "facts": [{"key": "owner-name", "label": "Owner"}], "tabs": [{"label": "Do", "items": ["ids"]}], "items": ["ITEM", {"sep": true}]}, "page": {"...": "optional: a right-click on empty page"}}}
catalog.kind: match is a CSS selector (default [data-hcm="<kind>"]); id names the data-* attribute(s) holding the target's id, first set wins (default hcm-id). EVERY data-* attribute of the matched element is a fact, keyed without 'data-' ({status}, {owner}); {id}, {href} (the first link inside), {href-abs}, {text}, {page}, {origin} and {kind} are always there. tabs is optional: a catalog that declares its own tabs keeps them and the model does not re-tab it.
catalog.item: {"id": "move", "label": "Move to", "icon": "columns" | "ph:<icon-font classes>" | "dot", "color": "a CSS colour or {fact}", "hint": "...", "kbd": "...", "when": COND, "on": COND, "maybe": true, "danger": true, "confirm": "Delete {display-id}?", "disabled": "why", "sub": [ITEM], "do": ACTION}
catalog.cond: {"status": "3"} equal, {"!status": "3"} not equal, {"owner": "*"} present, {"owner": ""} absent; values may be {templated}; all clauses must hold. `when` decides whether the item is drawn; `on` draws the check for the current value.

action.copy: {"type": "copy", "text": "{href-abs}", "toast": "Link copied."} -- falls back to a selection copy where the clipboard API is unavailable
action.post: {"type": "post", "url": "...", "values": {}, "toast": "...", "then": "reload" | {"htmx": {"url": "", "target": "", "swap": ""}} | {"event": "name", "target": "selector"} | {"navigate": "url"}} -- form-encoded, with X-CSRFToken (body[data-csrf], a csrfmiddlewaretoken input, or a *csrftoken cookie) and HX-Request. A 4xx/5xx toasts the server's own words; a 204 is 'Nothing changed.'; only a 2xx with content earns the item's toast.
action.htmx: {"type": "htmx", "method": "GET", "url": "...", "target": "#modal-slot", "swap": "innerHTML"} -- success is read off the request: a 204 or an HX-Trigger response is the app speaking for itself
action.click: {"type": "click", "selector": "..."} -- presses a control inside the target (or on the page): reuse the app's own button rather than re-describe it
action.emit: {"type": "emit", "event": "app:thing", "detail": {}} -- the app's own script does it
action.ask: {"type": "ask", "question": "..."} -- asks the page's agent component (hub:agent-ask); without an agent that takes it, the question is copied to the clipboard and the toast says so

smart.request: POST <smart-url>  {app, app_name, page, kind, kind_label, role, items: [{id, label, hint, group, sub, maybe, danger}], facts: {key: short value, 40 chars or fewer}, recent: [{id, n}], has_agent}
smart.hub: The hub asks the model it is configured with (HUB_MENU_MODEL_URL / HUB_MENU_MODEL, else the HUB_JUDGE_* model) and VALIDATES the answer: unknown ids are dropped and counted, only `maybe` items may be hidden, a destructive item is never pinned. Cached six hours per (app, page, kind, role, item set). GET /hub/api/menu/rank reports whether a model is configured, the timeout and the counts since the process started -- never the model's address.
smart.failed: {"ok": false, "reason": "unconfigured" | "failed", "error": "..."} -- the menu draws the catalog's order with no star; the mount gets data-hcm-smart="unconfigured" or "failed"
smart.never_waits: The menu is drawn before the answer. The component prefetches once per kind when the page loads and keeps the answer for the session, so a slow model costs nothing.

events.hub-menu:open: on document, cancelable -- preventDefault keeps the browser's own menu; detail.add(item) adds an item for THIS target
events.hub-menu:action: on document: {kind, id, item, target, facts, action} before any action runs
events.hub-menu:done: on document: {kind, id, item, status, body} after a post or htmx action landed
events.hub:agent-ask: dispatched on document for an `ask` action, cancelable, detail {question}; the agent component cancels it once it has taken the question
events.hub:component-props: window event, detail {app, props}; props['context-menu'] overrides the fetched values without a reload
events.window.HubMenu: {version, open(target, x, y), close(), register(kind, def), kinds(), smart()} -- smart() reports each kind's model state and error, for debugging from the console

rules: THE HUB SERVES THE COMPONENT AND NEVER AN APP'S DATA. Every URL in a catalog is a path on the app's own origin behind its own sign-in; the component can only run what the catalog declared.

A WRITE GOES THROUGH THE APP'S OWN ENDPOINT, the one its drawer or form already uses, so the app's permission checks and audit trail apply exactly as they do there. Declare a write item with `when` on the reader's rights; the endpoint still decides.

NOTHING DESTRUCTIVE FIRES ON ONE PRESS. An item with `confirm` arms on the first press and runs on the second, on the same open; anything else disarms it. `danger` marks it. The model may never pin one.
A MODEL FAILURE DOES NOTHING. No model, a timeout or a bad reply leaves the catalog's own order and no star; the model can never add an item, remove a core item, or change an action.
SUCCESS IS WHAT THE APP SAID. A refusal toasts the server's words; a 204 or an HX-Trigger response is the app speaking for itself; only a 2xx with content earns the item's own toast.
TEXT FIELDS KEEP THE BROWSER'S MENU. A right-click inside input, textarea, select or contenteditable, or anything under [data-hcm-native], is left alone.
SCROLL CLOSES IT ONLY WHEN THE TARGET MOVED, and the menu takes focus back once if the page's own handler took it on the same gesture.
AN ERROR IN THE COMPONENT IS RETHROWN off the stack so the app's error visibility forwards it; the gesture falls back to the browser's own menu.
A LIVE PAGE THAT SWAPS THE TARGET OUT closes the menu (htmx:afterSettle), so it never writes to a record that is no longer there.

keyboard.a letter: jump to the next item starting with it
keyboard.Escape: close, and focus goes back to the target

props.label: Organised by the model
props.hint: On: the hub's model arranges this app's declared actions -- the likeliest at the top, tabs when there are many, questions for the agent -- and can never add or change an action. Off: the catalog's own order.

props.label: Tabs
props.hint: Split a long menu into tabs. Never keeps one list, however long.

props.label: Recently used row
props.hint: Each person's own two most-used actions at the top, once they have used them a few times. Kept in their browser only.

props.label: Header line
props.hint: What was right-clicked, named at the top of the menu.

props.label: Facts line
props.hint: The values the app says matter (owner, due, status) under the header.
